name: Weaponmaster
description: A master-at-arms wielding a sword twice their size.

abilities.name: Goading Strike
abilities.description: Make a standard attack against a target. On a success, mark a Stress to Taunt the target until their next successful attack. The next time the Taunted target attacks, they have disadvantage against targets other than the Weaponmaster.

abilities.name: Adrenaline Burst
abilities.description: Once per scene, spend a Fear to clear 2 HP and 2 Stress.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.description: When the Weaponmaster makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
